page.title: People
page.introOwner: Invite family, friends or co-workers. Guests see only the chats you add them to; members can also use the agents you share. You stay the only owner.
page.introOther: You were invited to this PasaBot. The owner decides what you can see.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.intro: You get a link to send them. It works once and stops working after 3 days.
invite.guestHint: A guest sees only the chats you pick below.
invite.memberHint: A member sees the chats you pick and can open chats with the agents you share.
invite.noChats: No chats yet. Create an agent first.
invite.pickChat: Pick at least one chat for a guest.
invite.linkHint: Send it only to the person you invite: whoever opens it first joins.

agents.title: Agents members can use
agents.intro: Members can start their own chat with these agents. Their messages run as them, never as you, so anything risky still asks you first.

member.title: Agents you can use
member.intro: Start your own chat with an agent the owner shared.
member.none: The owner hasn't shared an agent with you yet.

guest.title: Your chats
guest.body: Your chats are in the list. The owner adds you to more when needed.
